/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B -c 'from solution import patch_query
cases = [
(\"preserve fragment\", \"https://example.invalid/p?a=1#frag\", [], \"https://example.invalid/p?a=1#frag\"),
(\"retain duplicates and blanks\", \"/p?a=1&b=&a=2\", [], \"/p?a=1&b=&a=2\"),
(\"replacement appends\", \"/p?a=1&b=2\", [(\"a\",\"3\")], \"/p?b=2&a=3\"),
(\"empty value\", \"/p?a=1\", [(\"a\",\"\")], \"/p?a=\"),
(\"literal reserved text\", \"/p\", [(\"k\",\"a&b+c%=d\")], \"/p?k=a%26b%2Bc%25%3Dd\"),
(\"decoded case sensitive keys\", \"/p?%61=1&A=2&a=3\", [(\"a\",None)], \"/p?A=2\"),
(\"sequential generator\", \"/p?a=1&b=2\", ((k,v) for k,v in [(\"a\",\"3\"),(\"a\",None),(\"a\",\"4\")]), \"/p?b=2&a=4\"),
(\"unicode encoding\", \"/p\", [(\"café\",\"雪\")], \"/p?caf%C3%A9=%E9%9B%AA\")]
for label,url,updates,expected in cases:
 actual=patch_query(url,updates)
 print((\"PASS\" if actual == expected else \"FAIL\"), label, \"actual=\",repr(actual), \"expected=\",repr(expected))
updates=[(\"a\",\"2\"),(\"b\",None)]
before=updates.copy()
patch_query(\"/p?a=1\",updates)
print(\"PASS input unchanged\" if updates == before else \"FAIL input mutated\")'"
